text: {"lessons":["My account rebounded to 93,737 after falling to 83,695.80, but it remains below its initial 98,248; I should judge progress over time, not let a short-term recovery obscure risk.","Selling 20 shares of Stock D above my average cost realized a gain, but I should base future buy or sell decisions on my plan and the portfolio’s needs, not just whether a stock is up.","I should review whether five individual stocks give me suitable diversification and keep new contributions aligned with my apartment goal and my ability to tolerate losses."]}
